title: Neoclouds, Explained: The GPU Landlords Renting Compute to the AI Boom
deck_short: The GPU landlords renting AI compute to the labs — and the debt that pays for it.

hero.alt: A row of glowing data-center halls at dusk, each filled with racks of graphics processors, power lines running in from a substation under a deep navy sky
hero.caption: A neocloud’s whole business is the GPU cluster: power and chips go in, rented AI compute comes out — that is the whole job.
hero.index_alt: Glowing data-center halls filled with graphics processors, power lines running in from a substation
hero.index_caption: Today’s lesson: neoclouds — the GPU landlords renting AI compute to the labs.

title: How AI Reads DNA, Explained: AlphaGenome 2 and the Cell-by-Cell Map of Disease
deck_short: The AI model that predicts which cell a DNA variant will affect — and why that finds disease.

hero.alt: A glowing strand of DNA unwinding above a field of different human cells — a heart muscle cell, an immune cell, a brain cell — each lit up in a different colour where the same gene is switched on
hero.caption: Every cell carries the same DNA. AlphaGenome 2 predicts how that DNA is read differently in each cell type — that is the whole job.
hero.index_alt: A glowing strand of DNA above different human cells, each lit up where the same gene is switched on
hero.index_caption: Today’s lesson: the AI that reads DNA cell by cell — and finds the variants that cause disease.

title: Robot Brains, Explained: How Vision-Language-Action Models Teach Machines to Work
deck_short: The model that lets a robot see, understand words, and move — and why it still drops things.

hero.alt: A humanoid robot on a car factory line, reaching into a bin of metal brackets and placing one into a tray in the right order
hero.caption: A vision-language-action model turns a camera image and a spoken instruction into the robot’s next move — that is the whole job.
hero.index_alt: A humanoid robot on a car factory line, reaching into a bin of metal brackets
hero.index_caption: Today’s lesson: robot brains — the model that lets a machine see, understand words, and move.

title: AI Agents, Explained: What They Are, How They Work, and Why Siri Wants to Be One
deck_short: A chatbot answers you. An agent does the job. The difference, the loop behind it, and the honest state of things.

hero.alt: A small robot assistant thinking at a desk, choosing between tools — a browser, code, a calendar, a database and a search — while it works toward a goal
hero.caption: An agent is given a goal and picks its own tools to reach it. The model decides the next step — that is the whole difference.
hero.index_alt: A small robot assistant thinking at a desk, choosing between tools — a browser, code, a calendar, a database and a search
hero.index_caption: Today’s lesson: AI agents — what they are, how they work, and why Siri wants to be one.
